messages:
maria: quick heads-up — proposing a 90min 'tracing installfest' with HW SI and Datadog next Tue 10am PT. goal: validate OTLP paths for both cloud marketplace demo and an airgapped onprem flow. who can own the runbook and sample dashboard?

sam: i can take runbook owner. will draft a minimal smoke test + rollback steps.

alex: can own sample dashboard + queries. i'll prepare a datadog tile that shows request traces, tail latency, and kv-cache hit rates.

leah: timeline check — marketing needs a 1 pager and screenshots by Thu so we can prep the joint announcement. is Tue -> Thu realistic?

sam: tight but doable if runbook draft lands by EOD Mon. i'll add a checklist: infra, collector, export, demo app, smoke tests, logs.

raj: heads-up on the onprem side: some SI partners will be airgapped. we need an offline OTLP collector bundle + cert instructions. alex — dashboard will need synthetic traces so we can demo without sending customer data.

alex: yep — will use replayed traces + redacted payloads. also building a small script to seed traces: `python tools/seed_traces.py --count 200 --sample 0.2`

maria: ops-bot — can you create a private calendar event and a shared doc at https://redwood-internal/obs/installfest?

ops-bot: created event "Tracing Installfest — HW + Datadog" for Tue 10:00–11:30 PT and a doc at https://redwood-internal/obs/installfest (edit access: sam, alex, leah, raj, maria). :white_check_mark:

sam: running through minimal runbook items here (will paste in doc):
- prereqs: testbed image, Datadog API key (demo), OTLP port open 4317
- steps: deploy collector -> configure export -> run demo app -> validate traces -> snapshot dashboard
- rollback: remove collector config, purge demo traces

alex: sample collector config i'll add to the doc; for quick local test: 
```
docker run --rm -p 4317:4317 -v $(pwd)/otel-config.yaml:/conf/config.yaml otel/opentelemetry-collector:latest 
  --config=/conf/config.yaml
```
config will export to `otlphttp://localhost:4318/v1/traces` or our datadog endpoint.

leah: legal/comms check — anyone flagged privacy or embargo concerns for screenshots? if we're using replayed traces and synthetic data, marketing is good. otherwise legal needs to review.

raj: will ensure seeding script redacts PII by default. i'll add a smoke test that asserts `trace.attributes` contains only allowed keys.

maria: great. action items: sam = runbook (owner), alex = dashboard + seed script, raj = airgap bundle + redaction, leah = marketing + legal gate, maria = partner invites + logistics. i'll ping Datadog partner PM to confirm attendance. deadline for doc first draft: Mon EOD. :spiral_calendar:

alex: also flagging a perf test — small burst of 1000 spans to ensure our dedicated GPU node doesn't choke the exporter. sam can we add perf step to runbook?

sam: yep adding perf step and SLO smoke check (p99 < 250ms for span export).

maria: thanks everyone. if any blocker pops up, drop it in the doc under "day-of risks" and tag me. otherwise i'll send invites + partner brief by EOD today. :thumbsup:
